Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Woodworking LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Woodworking LLC specializes in custom woodworking and carpentry services, including the design and creation of furniture, cabinetry, and architectural woodwork. Our operations include both new construction and renovation projects, focusing on residential and small commercial clients. We pride ourselves on using high-quality materials, while also ensuring compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations. Our team is experienced in handling various wood types, including domestic hardwoods and softwoods, and employs skilled craftsmen to deliver exceptional craftsmanship. We maintain a clean and organized workshop, adhere to local building codes, and have implemented safety measures to protect both our employees and clients during operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 12, 2022, a worksite accident resulted in a minor injury to an employee while operating a table saw, leading to a claim of $2,500. The claim was resolved quickly, and the employee returned to work the following week, with no further complications. Status: Closed. On July 25, 2023, an incident occurred involving a customer trip and fall in the workshop due to a misplaced tool; the claim amount was $2,500. The claim is currently under review.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1 Safe, UL Listed, Grade A, Commercial Security Label
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and a 24-hour on-site watchperson ensure protection of materials and equipment at the workshop.
